class_id: a batch job that records a unit as DONE when its worker found nothing to do, while the reason the unit was selected is still unresolved
feature: any selector + worker + completion-ledger job where the SELECTOR chooses units by one signal (a stuck document, a backlog count) and the WORKER acts through a different mechanism that may have no work for that unit, and the ledger excludes DONE units from future runs
symptom: the worker returns 'nothing due' (no rows to walk, no fields to fill) and the job maps that to DONE. The unit is then excluded from every later run, although the condition that selected it (the stuck item) is untouched. The run summary reads all green (attempted=N done=N) while the backlog it exists to drain does not shrink. It is invisible to counts of failures because nothing failed; it shows only by comparing the selection signal before and after.
first_seen: 2026-09-23 -- IPODhan closed-IPO job (scraper/src/scheduler/closed-ipo-job.ts), issue #717, first real cycle on staging after owner decision A. Selected 10 closed IPOs by stuck extractable documents; resourceClosedIpo ran walkFieldPlanForIPO; the IPOs had 0 ipo_field_plan rows; every one returned fieldsWritten 0, stoppedReason NO_DUE_FIELDS and was written to closed_ipo_resourcing as DONE (10 of 10). PROSPECTUS PENDING on staging: 74 before, 74 after. The candidate query re-picks only PARTIAL/FAILED, so the 10 are excluded for good. Flag turned off again the same cycle.
fix_prs: fix/closed-ipo-job-extracts-documents (PR pending, part of #717): the job now extracts the selected IPO's PENDING extractable documents through processPendingFilings before the walk, and runClosedIpoJob re-reads the pending count after the worker and downgrades DONE to PARTIAL while any remains; wrongly-DONE rows are reopened by scraper/scripts/repair-closed-ipo-false-done.ts (dry run on staging lists the 10).
detection_check: closed_ipo_false_done (scripts/audit-detection-floor.mjs, predicate findClosedIpoFalseDone in scripts/lib/detection-floor-checks.mjs): flags every DONE row with fields_written = 0 whose IPO still holds a PENDING extractable document, by IPO name. Generalisable: for every selector+ledger job, compare the selection signal for DONE units before and after; DONE with the signal unchanged is a failure.
